courses/math-grade-2/u01-3/exit-13.md. Read the graph report. Show the separate graph only to the adult reading the report; children reconstruct the picture.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-3/exit-14.md. Read all the labels aloud. Accept a mark on the requested tape span.

courses/math-grade-2/u01-3/exit-16.md. Cover the second response panel until the choice of owner is saved.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/exit-17.md. Save the paper groupings before the exit discussion. Keep this apart from the facts record.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/exit-18.md. Save the graph before reading the second cue. Collect the graphs and comparison marks separately from G.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/exit-box-06.md. Place this prompt in the student page Exit box. Save the mark before partner talk. Return it on day 7.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/hook-dots.md. Read one prompt at a time. Children mark their copy before discussion.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/retrieval-facts.md. Use as an unscored retrieval. Read one cue at a time and save first marks.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/retrieval-pictures.md. Use as an unscored retrieval. Read one cue at a time and save first marks.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/ten-frame.md. Use one frame on day 2 and both on day 3. Hand-rule two rows of equal boxes if there is no printer.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/part-cards.md. Cut by row. Move the shown groups on a frame, hide or slide one away, then name a related fact.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/pictures-mika.md. Use one action at a time. Place large scraps on the frames; mark the unknown change before finding it.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/route-strip.md. Use familiar routes from grade 1. Cover the second route until partners have tried independently.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/ten-strips.md. Fold between the fifth and sixth cells. Draw cells on folded scrap and use wide scraps as ones if needed.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/pile-record.md. Start with two groups; use the record after making the groups. Printed rows are optional supplied piles.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/practice-fact-cards.md. Use only the column for the day. Handwrite cards if needed. Check against the reserved families before adding any card.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/move-cards.md. Cut each row as one card. Fold the target flap and write the teacher-key target inside it before dealing. Draw rows from a cup in place of a die.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-1/game-strip.md. Draw a paired move card and save the strip. A handwritten strip is sufficient.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-2/object-cards.md. Use this set if classroom objects are unavailable or the class tally matches a held case. Cut the cards or point to each picture once.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-2/tally-chart.md. Use four drawn boxes instead of bins. Read or draw the headings. Check the whole tray against the tallies.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-2/sort-first-ballot.md. Read both neutral choices. One unsigned choice per child. A handwritten strip replaces the printed ballot.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-2/symbol-cards.md. Cut large paper symbols or draw the same-sized mark in each place. Use one mark for each object. Keep the sample outside the data.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-2/picture-rows.md. The teacher models matching with the equal symbol cards. Use brush and ruler counts for the arithmetic fallback.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-2/bar-grid.md. Fill equal intervals from zero. Hand-rule a grid if necessary. Use the folder counts for the arithmetic fallback.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-2/graph-pair.md. Use the same order on both graphs. Save both forms. Use red and green for the arithmetic fallback.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-2/part-whole-sheet.md. Place paper folder shapes into two drawn bins. Rejoin the parts before saving the split for day 12.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-2/question-cards.md. Partners sort the printed cards by question type, then swap their own questions. A partner may ask for clarification.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-3/comparison-bars.md. Match bars from zero. Use unequal practice lengths only. Children mark the common length before writing a difference.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-3/trace-tapes.md. Align ruled strips at zero, turn them together and then remove the grid. Then fill the missing label on the unruled tape.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-3/covered-tapes.md. Make separate still views of Al’s and Bo’s tab lengths. Cover one label at a time with a wide scrap. Draw aligned strips if none are printed.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-3/pictures-dana.md. Move wide slips or draw marks to reconstruct one start at a time. Rejoin the proposed parts during Model.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-3/fold-stories-practice.md. Show one person’s still panel per scene. Compare the two readings and discuss why Ria is larger in both. Children may draw their own tapes.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/collection-record.md. Use a familiar collection. Group a different way on the back. Spread large paper scraps or use this picture without loose materials.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/drawing-mark-ballot.md. Ask which drawing mark each child would choose. Give one unsigned slip per child in each group. Use scrap slips if needed.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/survey-tally.md. Tally all choices before handing out graph forms. Recount slips if the tally is lost. If both are missing, collect a fresh anonymous ballot before scoring.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/survey-picture.md. Use the group’s actual tally. Keep all four labels, including any category with zero votes.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/survey-bars.md. Use the group’s actual tally. Keep all four labels, including any category with zero votes.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/survey-calculations.md. Read the three prompts separately. Use the child’s saved bar graph. Keep the first marks for revision.

courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/assessment-stories-01.md. Read the exact prompts in order. Uncover one response at a time. Keep every first mark. Ask children to use a square for the missing amount in an equation.

courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/assessment-stories-06.md. Read the exact prompts in order. Uncover one response at a time. Keep every first mark. Ask children to use a square for the missing amount in an equation.

courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/assessment-stories-11.md. Read the exact prompts in order. Uncover one response at a time. Keep every first mark. Ask children to use a square for the missing amount in an equation.

courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/assessment-stories-12.md. Read the exact prompts in order. Uncover one response at a time. Keep every first mark. Ask children to use a square for the missing amount in an equation.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/assessment-related.md. Save the related equations before asking about one subtraction. Record any scribed words beside the paper mark.
courses/math-grade-2/u01-4/feedback-strip.md. Attach private feedback to the original. Each child has the shared seven minutes to mark changes in F and G.

courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/tens-and-ones.md. Before class, cut ten connected cells as one rod and cut the ones panel into single cells. One cell has the same width in each panel. Use drawn rods and equal-size dots in a room without loose pieces.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/ten-frame.md. Review the ten-frame. Place one large paper square in each filled cell or use pencil marks.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/hook-tens.md. Read the numbers aloud. Ask how many more 42 has. Match and remove like units on the frame. Use a drawn rod and dots if needed.

courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/review-graph.md. Review the survey. Read one cue at a time for the total, the difference and the down count. Use tally and matching marks and keep the graph for arithmetic only.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/key-hook-and-graph.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/retrieval-20a.md. Read each cue aloud. Read the two calculations in space 1 separately. Record gaps to repair, without a readiness score.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/retrieval-20b.md. Continue after marks A. Read one cue at a time. Use blank drawing space for the two tapes and keep the original marks.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/key-retrieval.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/sum-explanations.md. Read both records. Save the child’s place-value mark. Keep the two totals private until discussion.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/key-two-ways.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/feedback-strip.md. Date the cue and any later retry. Use one pictured move at a time and retain first marks.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/missing-part.md. Review the missing part. Read the model question first. On the other rows show the known part and leave the unknown open, then rejoin the two parts.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/key-missing-part.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/seal-moves.md. Read each scene in forward order. Cover start, change or result one at a time. Rebuild the rest before changing the covered label.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/practice-tapes.md. Review the tape diagram. Use the length of a strip for the amount. Draw an agreed common start for a comparison on scrap.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/key-seal-moves.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/mixed-cards.md. Cut at each border or copy the cues onto scrap. Review Partner turns. One partner calculates while the other checks with a related calculation, then switch.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-1/key-calculation-cards.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-2/bank-mat.md. Use folded paper trays or pencil boxes. Match one rod to its ten equal units before swapping. Keep pieces on tables and prepare any cuts before class.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-2/bank-cards.md. Read one removal at a time. Pairs exchange one marked paper rod, subtract the required ones and check the amount left. Draw the trade as an alternate path.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-2/key-bank.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-2/contrast-record.md. Read both rows with the same starting amount. Mark how many ones each removes.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-2/key-contrast.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-2/completed-contrasts.md. These are completed teaching examples. Read each equality aloud and show which quantities the marks describe.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-2/key-completed-contrasts.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-2/started-exchanges.md. Sketch the tens and ones named on each record. Have children mark removals on the started records and track every addend in the grouping.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-2/key-started-exchanges.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-2/method-trace.md. Use drawn rods beside the completed records. Connect each trade and removal to a written step. Hold pieces for a private repair if needed.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-2/key-method-trace.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/mixed-written.md. Alternate short facts and written work, then group four addends. Children may draw their own marks. Put supplied base-ten pieces away.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/key-mixed-written.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/partner-rounds.md. Use one card a turn. Partners calculate and check privately, then switch. Handwrite the same cards when there is no printer.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/grouping-records.md. Read each pairing aloud. Have children match or tick the same addends in both records.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/key-partner-and-grouping.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/sorted-sheets.md. Review the paper tape diagram. Read each prompt aloud and use a fresh neutral outline. For the comparison children align their own strips.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/key-sorted-sheets.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/covered-tapes.md. Review part-whole tapes. For the second example have children mark one split with the first part from 49 to 52. Draw strips on scrap if needed.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/comparison-slips.md. Use separate slips. Read one wording on each. Save each paper mark before giving feedback.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/key-tapes-and-slips.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/quantity-labels.md. Review Day 14 Al and Bo tabs using the fresh labels. Label the longer and shorter quantities before recovering the covered label.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-3/key-quantity-labels.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/peg-pictures.md. Read the scenes one at a time. Save the first action before presenting the next. Have children draw their own action tapes.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/key-peg-pictures.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/action-record.md. Review first and then on separate paper spaces. Draw your own tapes in the blank boxes. Use blank paper as the stand-in.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/action-cards.md. Cut at each border. Each partner authors a one-actor story in a plain setting, then trades it for the other partner to solve.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/key-action-cards.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/mixed-stories.md. Read one cue aloud at a time. Use the supplied labels for practice and record the original marks before any correction.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/key-mixed-stories.md.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/explain-addition.md. Give each child eight independent minutes. Hear roster positions 1 to 15 privately. Preserve initial and revised marks.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/explain-subtraction.md. Give each child eight independent minutes. Hear roster positions 16 to 30 privately. Preserve both marks at revision.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/stock-inventory.md. Use the four stock counts only on the assessment. Read them aloud and allow twelve minutes. Keep the separate tray off this sheet.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/star-tray.md. Read the story and cue aloud. Allow eight minutes for the labeled action tapes, square equations and the check. Keep the original.

courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/closing-revision.md. Use one dated box for each return. Keep it beside the original. On day 37 use one for addition. On day 38 use separate boxes for the stock, tray and subtraction.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/assessment-stories-01.md. Read each scene and its one cue aloud. Give two minutes per story. Save the first picture, square equation and number before moving on.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/assessment-stories-05.md. Read each scene and its one cue aloud. Give two minutes per story. Save the first picture, square equation and number before moving on.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/assessment-stories-09.md. Read each scene and its one cue aloud. Give two minutes per story. Save the first picture, square equation and number before moving on.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/assessment-stories-12.md. Read each scene and its one cue aloud. Give two minutes per story. Save the first picture, square equation and number before moving on.
courses/math-grade-2/u02-4/fluency-assessment.md. Read each calculation aloud separately. Give ten minutes total. Use no objects or supplied models. Record accuracy and strategy separately.
